description: An elegant and flexible PDF viewer for Bubble. Custom UI, themes, zoom presets, search with highlight, thumbnails and bookmarks, watermark, protected mode, workflow actions and events, plus PDF tools (extract, merge, fill forms, stamp images) and multi-language display.
name: PDF Vision Viewer
plugin_instructions: Place the Pdf View element and set 'PDF Url'. Optional: theme/colors, initial zoom, language (auto/en/pt/fr/es/de), watermark text, protected mode and toolbar visibility. Use the exposed states (current page, total pages, zoom, search results, title/author, error), the events (loaded, error, page changed, search completed, download/print started) and the element actions (navigation, zoom, search, download, print, rotate, extract/merge/fill/stamp) in your workflows. The file's host must allow CORS; Bubble-hosted files work out of the box.
